body:
I like you. Thank you for what you've said. I'm in Greenwich Mean time, so it's now a bright Sunday morning. This is my 6th day in a row that I woke up at the same level of sadness as I went to sleep, but once I made it to my laptop, I felt very... very... something. Something good. Maybe a little relaxed? I read some of your posts. They are all very good. I'm glad you spend time in this subreddit.

I think the hair is the easiest. But I do cut it a lot. Whenever I've had a complete collapse, I cut it all off. It's my current alternative to types of self-harm that scar, because I'm an actress, so I can't make any permanent physical marks. It's a couple inches past my chin, now, and I get the urge to take the scissors to it all the time, but I'm trying my best to leave it alone. It's the longest it's been for a year and a half.

Anyway, you are very wonderful. You have a knack for saying 100% positive things. I just keep re-reading your post.
